Results.ReviewText:
When my husband went on the carnivore diet it became "too much" to clean up the stove of meat grease every meal and he suggested getting a grill.  I was intimidated by the thought of grilling every day (I'd never grilled before in my life at 52, LOL!), but the thought of a continuously clean kitchen encouraged me...and I'm SO HAPPY WE GOT IT!!!  

It's SUPER EASY to use, the perfect size for 6 1/3 lb burgers (although I usually cook 3 at a time). I LOVE the built in grill thermometer.  It helps a lot since just timing it doesn't account for ambient temperature and that does affect pre-heat and grilling times; it's winter in New England so whether it's 25 or 40 degrees outside makes a difference.

I recommend a stainless steel "fish turner" type of flipper; it's perfect for getting between the grill and the charred goodness of the burger so half of it isn't stuck.  Of course, having the grill hot enough and leaving it long enough before turning is essential, but the beveled edge of the fish spatula along with its thinness makes it almost a given that you're going to get all the yummy browned part on your plate.  Not that that's a review of the grill, just a tip.
Results.Title: PERFECT for two, EASY and FUN!

ClientResponses.Response:
Your feedback is very important to us. We want you to get the most out of your grill, and we are sorry to learn that you are disappointed.

With the lid closed and empty grates, a brand-new grill will run hotter than usual. We recommend running the grill on low with the grates filled with food in order to determine the low temperature. We expect it to be about 375F-400.

If you are interested in doing low-and-slow cooking, a model with more area for indirect cooking could be a better fit.

Your satisfaction is very important to us. If you need any further assistance please don't hesitate to reach out directly. Thank you for being a long time Weber fan!

Results.ReviewText: I purchased the Weber 1200Q and it's stand.   In most ways I am very happy.   I also bought the hose that lets me connect the unit to a 25lb tank as I have found that it gets very expensive to use 1lb bottles.   However, I found that it gets way to hot on even the lowest setting wrecking very good EXPENSIVE meat.   To check to make sure I was right I bought two 1lb bottles which worked great.   I have checked many stores to try to find an adjustable regulator to knock the pressure down but unable to find one with the correct threads.   I also checked the Weber site and could not find one.   Disappointing problem with and otherwise great product.  I have a Silver Weber at home that is over 25 years old and recommend it to all my friends but would not recommend the 1200Q  (we use it in our RV for 6 mths a year) because of the above issue.
Results.Title: Disappointing heat control

Results.ReviewText:
This is a nice grill design for items that you will watch closely.  It is an attractive unit.  Its single burner design doesn't allow for a cooler place on the grill to get indirect heating.  Setting the heat only sets the rate of heating, not the temperature.  This makes it imperative that you periodically raise the lid to regulate the temperature for items that are thicker.  Flare ups are common as the lid is vented on both sides and the grease hole in the bottom is large.  This is an open single burner and heats up very quickly.   So, it takes some time to get used to this grill.  Once you understand how this grill cooks you can adapt your cooking method to achieve very good results.  
The grill is relatively easy to clean, but the grease on the bottom of the bowl can build up and periodic cleaning is essential.  
So far, we are satisfied with our purchase as it is small enough to be portable in our camping trailer and eliminates the need and mess of charcoal.  It produces a lot of heat and the squirrels can't get into it with the lid closed.  For our purposes it is acceptable but it would not replace a larger multi-burner unit temperature controlled unit for general outside grilling use.
Results.Title: Fancy, Stylish, Portable, Compact
